dedupe_keys.name: sabu shared intrusion detection alerts and network enrichments

description: This dataset contains almost twelve million alerts collected during 11–17 March 2019 from the SABU intrusion-alert sharing platform. The research collaborators combine thirty-four detection systems, honeypots and other sources deployed at three Czech organizations, including a research network, campus and commercial provider, to support collaborative security analysis. Alerts use the IDEA representation, with auxiliary information on more than 1.7 million anonymized IP identifiers, approximate locations, reputation and passive-DNS characteristics. Mendeley provides five CSV and ZIP files free under CC BY 4.0. Alert records reflect detector behaviour and reporting rules, not a complete census of malicious packets or confirmed compromises. Anonymization and unequal source coverage further limit reconstruction of actual network topology. A reviewer-assessed use is testing alert-correlation agents or security-monitoring assumptions in network resilience simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related network simulation environment, without a verified IDEA import interface. No alerts, enrichment files or detection rules were executed.
